links.outcome: Inter-rater agreement between radiologists, and between radiologists and LLM judges (QWK)
links.effect: Radiologist-LLM judge QWK -0.04 to 0.15; between the 2 radiologists QWK 0.01 to 0.06, indicating poor agreement in reference ratings.
links.quote: Agreement between the 2 radiologists was also poor (QWK=0.01 to 0.06).

links.outcome: Agreement of LLM-as-a-judge with expert radiologist evaluation of translations
links.effect: LLM judges favored the LLM translation in 70%-99% of cases with near-zero agreement with radiologists (QWK -0.04 to 0.15); expert radiologist review remains important.
links.quote: For educational use of translated radiology reports, automated LLM-based evaluation alone is insufficient; expert radiologist review remains important.
